557)bzlog rol chi ba/'ur/drag rol che ba/'ur/hūm̐/chos kyi dbying nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/khro bo rol pa'i 'ur phrod chen po nas/shin tu mi bza

tei:div.tei:p: bzlog rol chi ba/ 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) drag rol che ba/ 'ur/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐/ chos kyi dbying nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ khro bo rol pa'i 'ur phrod chen po nas/ shin tu mi bzad= sogs/ dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ ༈ drag rol chung ba/ nga ni dpal chen= 'dur/ gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du bzlog (Musical notes and signs here) sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) ༈ drag rol 'bring ba/ (Musical notes and signs here) shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas/ khrag mdog dmar mo bse yi lan phran can/ smin ma sprul= dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs la sogs/ phung po dum bur gtub cing don snying ma lus sregs/ (Musical notes and signs here) sil/ 558) ༈ bka' brgyad rol mo byin rlabs che ba ni/ thing gsum/ dung chen/ sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) de 'dra cha bcu gnyis/ (Musical notes and signs here) thing gsum/ sil/ rkang*/ ḍā gzhag ༈ bka' brgyad byin rlabs 'bring po/ dung*/ thing gsum/ sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) thing gsum/ sil/ rkang*/ ḍā/ bzhag rol/ ༈ sum gnyis/ 'jog med/ 'ur mthar/ (Musical notes and signs here) 559) cho ga gang rung la 'khrul pa sbubs bshig sbrel na/ dpal chen 'dus par mtshon na/ las byang bsnyen pa/ stong tshig yan grub mtshams/ yum ka'i me mchod kyi dbu nas mnyam sbyor byin za 'bar ba'i klongaḥ bh+ruṃ rarna bhañja= sogs/ bstod pa yan/ hūm̐ dgang blugs= kha bsgyur spyi ltar/ thob par dmigasaḥ tshe 'das rnams shes ya yig= bshigs/ rtsa sngags dang*/ a nri k+ṣa/ sbrel ba bdun/ tshe las 'das pa'i ma rig gzung 'dzin las nyon bag chags kyi 'khrul sbubs thams cad ma rā ya phaṭaḥ de 'dra gsum/ rdzas sngags brgya mtshams/ 'dod gsol re/ de 'dras bsngags mthar/ dkon mchog gsum dang sgrub pa bka' brgyad= sogs/ rak+ṣa hūṃ/ gos zung dang*/

so tsi gsol/ gnyis/ tshogs lhag ma bro yan/ gtang rag mchod bstod/ bshags/ gshegs gsol/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis bcas mtha' bsdu/ rten phyi ma rnams la zhi khro la sogs sbyong pa lta bu'i gnas 'dren sbyar/ bsregs thal chu la dor ba'am/ mnan par bya/ 560)
